answer: The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 310 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. Because the timing is written down against the lagoon challenge, the sable audit can replay the jetty history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A farm of 3604 identities would post 3980 proofs and burn roughly 36 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
